text:
linda: FYI — AtlasHealth renewal is stuck on e-sign. Procurement says the signer on the doc isn't authorized for the billing entity listed. DocSend link: https://docsend.com/atlas-renewal-0426 :worried:

matt: ugh. Which billing entities? they split across US / EU, right?

linda: Yes — two invoices: `AtlasHealth, Inc.` (US, vendorcode A-220) and `AtlasHealth Europe Ltd` (EU, vendorcode A-221). Legal signed one copy for the US entity but procurement needs delegated sign-off for the EU entity too.

rebecca: Can you paste the signer block from the current DocuSign? need to confirm delegation language.

linda: "Signer: Jonathan Price — Title: VP Finance" on the contract. Procurement sent an email showing the EU AP approver is Sophie Leclerc and says delegation certificate is missing.

shona: do we have a procurement-approved delegated signing certificate on file for Sophie? I thought we stored entity-specific signers in Salesforce under the billing entity.

alan: Checking SF now — for AtlasHealth Europe Ltd I only see Sophie as "billing contact" but no signed delegation doc attached.

matt: Procurement is pushing to get a PO and e-sign this week to hit renewal cutoff. If we can't get delegation, can we accept a single master PO covering both entities temporarily?

rebecca: legal: we can accept a single PO if customer signs an amendment adding Sophie as delegated signee for the EU entity OR we can add a clause allowing a named AP approver to sign on behalf of the local affiliate. Need their explicit email + a short delegation attestation.

linda: I just DM'd procurement contact (procurement@atlashealth.com) asking them to provide Sophie's delegation attestation (scanned letter or company stamp) and confirm email.

esign-bot: DocuSign update: envelope 0x7f4 sent to jonathan.price@atlas.com (signed). pending recipient sophie.leclerc@atlas-eu.com (not added to envelope).

shona: If we get the attestation today we can: 1) create a separate envelope for the EU entity and route to Sophie; or 2) update the current agreement with an amendment and route to Sophie — option 1 is faster for e-sign flow.

matt: I'd prefer option 1 (separate envelope) to avoid re-sending Jonathan. less friction.

rebecca: Agreed. But legal needs the attestation doc uploaded and countersigned. Also ask procurement for the exact vendorcode they want on the EU PO (A-221?).

linda: Procurement responded — they attached a scanned delegation letter and confirmed vendorcode `A-221`. I'll upload to SF now and create an envelope just for the EU billing entity with Sophie as signer.

linda: Quick checklist I'm following: 1) attach delegation letter to SF record (done) 2) create EU-specific envelope (in progress) 3) set PO vendorcode A-221 on invoice metadata 4) confirm email match for Sophie before send 5) notify renewals when signed so we can invoice.

alan: tagging @shona — once signed I can generate the EU invoice with vendorcode field; just confirm in SF the billing entity is `AtlasHealth Europe Ltd`.

shona: confirmed. I'll watch the envelope and approve net terms on receipt.

linda: sending EU envelope now...

esign-bot: DocuSign update: envelope 0x8a2 created, recipient sophie.leclerc@atlas-eu.com invited at 2623456800.

matt: :thumbsup: awesome. I’ll update the renewal tracker to show pending EU signature instead of blocked.

rebecca: once Sophie signs, I'll review the amendment language and confirm countersign. If anything odd, I'll escalate.

linda: Great — thanks team. I'll post final status here.
